rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AA label, but it overstates certainty from a single image by claiming clearly compact/polarized ICM and uniformly cohesive AA TE; some features are not crisply discernible and the image support is only moderate.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcome, male factor, BMI, endometrium, and stimulation context with embryo quality and prognosis in a clinically meaningful way.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a transparent probability rationale; minor issues include overconfident morphology-to-euploidy inferences and some speculative adjustments.

Core points such as SET and age-adjusted prognosis are aligned, but several adjuncts/recommendations (aspirin, steroids, ERA after limited failure, endometrial scratch, NK testing, GH/DHEA) are not strongly guideline-supported for routine use.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, though some suggestions are more speculative than standard and should be framed more cautiously.
